origin: Archive discovery by target and dates only. The ExoFOP public file index lists a photometry measurement table for 2020-07-26, a date in TESS Sector 27. The previous public holdout used TESS sectors 6, 7, 8, 12, 61–63, 65–68, 87–90, 93–96 and 98. No transit flux, fitted midpoint, timing catalogue event or observer note for the candidate was inspected in selecting this event.

held_case.ground_role: TIC 55652896.01 outer-planet observation in ExoFOP grid

data_custody: Use raw photometry from two physically distinct instruments. Run each reducer separately from only its own flux and explicit time columns. Freeze both output digests before reading centre comparisons. Use the frozen Activation 1.5 joint TESS and ground limb-darkened implementations without changing their fit parameters. Previously disclosed timings are not confirmation labels.
clock_rule: Require explicit BJD_TDB in each source. Ground AstroImageJ verifies both BJD_TDB and JD_UTC and reports their offset; TESS requires TIMESYS=TDB and BJDREF. No timing inference from timestamps with unresolved base or scale.
acceptance: Require one MEASURE TESS event of the scheduled ground planet in the 72-hour band with independently observed ground detection. All ground model variants must support depth 0.010–0.025, full duration 4.3–6.8 hours, at least 5 exposures before and after and 3 in each contact, and no active center, duration or depth bound. Require finite strictly positive conditional timing scales at most 300 seconds for each instrument. Require absolute midpoint difference at most max(120 seconds, 3 times combined quadrature scales), then report one-sigma interval overlap independently. TESS outputs and ground outcomes outside the admissible case remain diagnostic. Preserve no-detection and ambiguity as abstention.
forecast_scope: Attribution evidence from a held historical event does not by itself calibrate predictive windows. No forecast comparison or observing recommendation may be admitted without independently held sequences and calibrated equal-or-better coverage. April 2023 remains diagnostic.
